name: Soverato (Italy)
description: Vertical bicolour of white and red, the white charged with the crowned municipal arms of Soverato (a tree on white in a yellow cartouche).
history: Municipal flag of Soverato, a comune in Calabria; Italian municipal arms, gonfaloni and flags are granted by decree of the President of the Republic on the advice of the Government's heraldry office.

features.role: Soverato arms — tree on white in a yellow cartouche, crowned
cartouche and crown of the arms
